> In development, I hope that user can invoke the RDP app by one click on the web page. I think URL Scheme is the answer.
>
> Actual tests have found that the support for RDP URL Scheme is incomplete.

## Platform

### MacOS

> rdp://full%20address=s%3A<ip>%3A<port>&username=s%3AAdministrator

manually install [RDP](https://learn.microsoft.com/zh-cn/windows-server/remote/remote-desktop-services/clients/remote-desktop-mac)

### Windows

1. It only supports launching the RDP client, but cannot pass any parameter.

> ms-rd://

### RDP File Download

The currently perfect support is for users to download and open the file manually. The File content is following.

> full address:s:9.9.9.9:3389
>
> username:s:administrator

Note: `Microsoft Remote Desktop` is required in MacOS.

### Docs

- [https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows-server/remote/remote-desktop-services/clients/remote-desktop-uri](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows-server/remote/remote-desktop-services/clients/remote-desktop-uri)
